The district has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the Congress since 2022.{{Cite web|title=LIST: New congressional districts in the 2022 elections|url=https://www.rappler.com/philippines/elections/list-new-congressional-districts-philippines-2022-polls/|access-date=2021-09-17|website=Rappler|date=24 June 2021 |language=en}} It is composed of municipalities of Sogod, Libagon, Liloan, San Francisco, Pintuyan, San Ricardo, Saint Bernard, Anahawan, San Juan, Hinunangan, Hinundayan and Silago.{{cite news|title=Southern Leyte Split|url=https://www.abs-cbn.com/focus/02/06/19/southern-leyte-split|date=6 February 2019|website=ABS-CBN News|access-date=4 March 2022}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Christopherson Yap]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP), who is the first representative of district since its creation.{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=June 10, 2023}} == Representation history == {| class="wikitable" !
